notes: This file contains public keys only; it is not a keypair, wallet, deploy config, npm config, secret-store reference, or signing instruction.
Operational signer scope is limited to fee-payer, test, and attestation signing flows that are separately approved through HQ.
The operational signer is not the chain-observed ProgramData upgrade authority and is not authorized to rewrite programs.
Read-only mainnet ProgramData evidence identifies the public upgrade authority value only; it does not prove private-key custody, storage class, or approval to use that key.
